The most central ring is nearly symmetrical, while the surrounding rings show slight elliptical deformation.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of irregular, high-intensity light pixel clusters is localized in the posterior dorsal region. These clusters appear as solid, non-gradient patches of light gray/white pixels with a tight spatial distribution along the upper curvature of the visible body mass.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most distinct central annuli form an obtuse triangle. The geometric relationship is defined by a horizontal base between two ventral-adjacent rings and a vertex formed by a larger dorsal-positioned ring.
